_comment: Run template for cofactor-drammen: a daily M&V baseline (ASHRAE Guideline 14) over calendar 2018 for every building's electricity import (ElImp, the AMS main meter) and district-heat import (HtDH), each weather-normalized on the building's own outdoor temperature (the oat role stored on each meter; no shared weather). The electricity baseline is change-point + an occupied-day driver (Monday to Friday except the 2018 Norwegian public holidays listed): these are schools, kindergartens, nursing homes and offices whose electricity follows the week as much as the weather (a temperature-only change-point meets the daily G14 acceptance on 12 of 45 meters in 2018, with the driver on 37). District heat is temperature-only. Meter data only, so no fault rules. 2018 precedes the spring 2020 COVID-19 closures and the building-6413 meter outage (see the entry's data issues); a reporting period in 2020-2021 needs a non-routine adjustment.
